title: Triangulation of the homotopy category over an additive category
statement: Let $\mathcal B$ be a preadditive category [def-weil-preadditive-category] with a zero object and binary biproducts. Let $K(\mathcal B)$ be the category of integer-indexed cochain complexes $(X^n,d_X^n)$, with $d_X^{n+1}d_X^n=0$, whose morphisms are chain maps modulo homotopies $f-g=d_Yh+hd_X$, $h^n:X^n\to Y^{n-1}$. Set $(X[1])^n=X^{n+1}$ with differential $-d_X$. For a chain map $f:X\to Y$, set $C(f)^n=Y^n\oplus X^{n+1}$ with differential $(y,x)\mapsto(d_Yy+f(x),-d_Xx)$; its cone triangle is $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow i C(f)\xrightarrow{-p}X[1]$, where $i$ and $p$ are the inclusion and projection. With this shift and distinguished triangles the triangles isomorphic to these cone triangles, $K(\mathcal B)$ is triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category].
